behavior: Only the pointer or touch that starts a slider press can move or release it. A press that stops before the control leaves no thumb selected. Disabling or replacing the control ends the press and releases capture. Release uses the last accepted gesture reason and drops a value if the number of thumbs or the model type changed. The next move uses range edits the parent made during valueChange. A press on thumbs stacked at the maximum selects an enabled thumb. A swap keeps focus on the new thumb after the pending track focus frame.
